decisions.reason: The source permits flexible connector placement under the already-established single-board architecture but does not change the sensor connector set, fanout role, assembly style, or consolidation policy.
Removal of the legacy main-board layer-stack requirement and the accompanying placement flexibility do not change BOM readiness, component sourcing, population, or assembly requirements.
The incidental reference to LEDs being easy to position does not change their selected part, supply voltage, data interface, power control, or required interconnect.
